description: Direct event setup on the built-in bitbucket_data_center source. Every create request body below is verified against the live CreatePromptAutomationRequest model in OpenHands/automation (openhands/automation/preset_router.py).

scenarios.description: A PROJECT/repo repository and the default tone. Preflight passes, the automation is created.

draft.name: Bitbucket Data Center code review
draft.prompt:
Review the Bitbucket Data Center pull request described in the event payload below, in the repository ENG/payments. Use a concise review tone.

1. Clone the repository with the Bitbucket Data Center token you receive as the bitbucket_data_center_token secret (use the bitbucket-data-center skill for authentication; the server's URL is in the payload's links). Fetch the pull request head with `git fetch origin refs/pull-requests/<id>/from` and check out the payload's fromRef.latestCommit.
2. Review the changes against the target branch for correctness, security, tests and maintainability. Run focused tests when they help confirm a finding.
3. Post the review through the Bitbucket Data Center REST API: inline comments on the lines that need changes, then one summary comment that names the reviewed commit.

Only read the repository and write pull request comments: never push, approve, decline or merge. If the pull request has no reviewable changes, post a short summary comment saying so.
